paragraphs.text: The high priest entered into the holiest of holies just once a year in the month of September.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: all times into the holy place

paragraphs.text: In Hebrew it is called Azazel, which some say is a mountain near Sinai, where this goat was sent. Rather it is called the scapegoat because it was not offered but sent into the desert, as in Le 16:11.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: That is, on the side which was toward the people: for the head of the sanctuary stood westward.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Placed among them who are unclean.
paragraphs.label: e
paragraphs.anchor: remaineth among them in the midst

paragraphs.text: Upon which the sweet incense and perfume was offered.
paragraphs.label: f
paragraphs.anchor: altar that is before the LORD

paragraphs.text: In this goat is a true figure of Jesus Christ, who bears the sins of the people, Is 53:9.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: upon the head of the goat

paragraphs.text: In the court where the laver was, Ex 30:28.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Which was Tisri, part September and part October.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: Meaning, by abstinence and fasting, Nu 29:7.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: Or a rest which you shall keep most diligently.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: Whom the priest shall anoint by God's commandment to succeed in his father's place.
